# Kinematics Simulation

> A physics simulator of motion machines (belt gantries, delta and parallel pickers, arms, parallel kinematics on
> cylinders and cables, cranes, presses, web handling) with a servo drive model: cycle loads per motor, sizing verdicts
> with error bands, catalogue motor search, loop margins, positioning accuracy, path error, FMU export. Rust; front
> ends: command line `sim-cli`, Python module `kinematics-sim` (PyPI), an MCP server, a desktop app, a browser page,
> FMI, OPC UA. Only one machine (a ball screw bench) has been measured: most parameters of the shipped configs are
> estimates with [bounds]; read "What it can and cannot tell you" before stating results as facts.

Docs site: https://sparkz400.github.io/KinematicsSimulation/docs/ (the same pages as docs/*.md in the repository,
https://github.com/Sparkz400/KinematicsSimulation).

## For LLMs and coding agents

- [MCP server](https://sparkz400.github.io/KinematicsSimulation/docs/mcp.html): `uvx --from "kinematics-sim[mcp]" kinematics-sim-mcp`, its tools, client config snippets
- [Using sim-cli from a coding agent](https://sparkz400.github.io/KinematicsSimulation/docs/mcp.html#using-sim-cli-from-a-coding-agent): the commands that answer the common questions, their CSV output and exit codes

## Start here

- [What it can and cannot tell you](https://sparkz400.github.io/KinematicsSimulation/docs/overview.html#what-it-can-and-cannot-tell-you): scope, validation, limits
- [Overview and tour](https://sparkz400.github.io/KinematicsSimulation/docs/overview.html): a five-minute tour of the command line with real output
- [Installing a release](https://sparkz400.github.io/KinematicsSimulation/docs/install.html)
- [User guide](https://sparkz400.github.io/KinematicsSimulation/docs/user-guide.html): every command, option and output column
- [Python module](https://sparkz400.github.io/KinematicsSimulation/docs/python.html): `kinematics_sim`, every function

## Reference

- [Config reference](https://sparkz400.github.io/KinematicsSimulation/docs/config-reference.html): every config key, with units in the key names
- [Machine files](https://sparkz400.github.io/KinematicsSimulation/docs/machine-files.html): a new machine from components, without Rust
- [Model reference](https://sparkz400.github.io/KinematicsSimulation/docs/model-reference.html): the equations
- [Mechanisms and transmissions](https://sparkz400.github.io/KinematicsSimulation/docs/mechanisms.html)
- [Catalogue](https://sparkz400.github.io/KinematicsSimulation/docs/catalogue.html): motors, drives, gearboxes, axes and where their data comes from
- [Validation](https://sparkz400.github.io/KinematicsSimulation/docs/validation.html): what each figure was checked against
